description: The Emoton UI served by the local server on http://127.0.0.1:8891 gets exactly what shared/native.ts lists and app/src/lib/native.ts calls: event listen/unlisten (menu events, webview drag-drop), window dragging for the title bar, dialog open/save, opener reveal/open, notifications. open_path is limited to source files inside a video bundle (*.emoton/sources/), by extension, so it can never launch a program.
